metric.purpose: The single oversized proof numeral on a screen whose job is to show what the user achieved. One per screen, tabular-nums, weight 700. Never a title or unmeasured copy.

metric-secondary.purpose: The second peak on the same screen, one step below Metric (the Insights streak). Subordinate figures drop to ledger rows instead.

metric-caption.purpose: The words read with a metric numeral, set on its baseline, capped at 25px so the number stays dominant.

display.purpose: The single screen title at the top of each screen.

title.purpose: Settings section headers and card titles.

body.purpose: Default working text at the app's 15px size.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows and small captions, tertiary color.

shadows.name: step-1
shadows.purpose: Resting card; the border does most of the work.

shadows.name: step-2
shadows.purpose: Hover and popovers (explainer popover, lifted interactive card).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions; only transform and opacity animate on the dictation path.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Rapid state changes: toggles, button hovers.

narrative.overview: Teletype is a precision tool for turning speech into clean, private, on-device text. The interface behaves like a well-made instrument: calm neutral surfaces, tight typographic hierarchy, and one violet accent that only fires when you act. The personality is refined and restrained: crisp hairline borders, small radii, tight padding, and low-contrast chrome, with interactive elements earning their elevation. Both light and dark are first-class themes, and dark is border-led rather than shadow-led.
keyCharacteristics: One chromatic accent (Teletype Violet) reserved for action, selection, and focus
Flat, hairline-bounded cards that lift on interaction rather than resting in shadow
A system font stack on a 12 to 28px working scale, plus one oversized metric numeral on the screen that proves the user's progress
Comfortable density on a 4px spacing rhythm; the whole row is the target
Light and dark are both real themes, dark carried by borders not shadows

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Teletype Violet is the only chromatic action color, used on a small fraction of any screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Border-Led Dark Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, do not reach for drop shadows to show depth. Raise the border's presence instead.

rules.name: The No-Heavy-Type Rule
rules.body: Weight tops out at 650 for display and 600 for body. There is no 700-plus display slab; confidence comes from size and tracking, not weight. The one exception is a metric numeral: the Metric tiers are 700 because a tabular figure at 58 to 96px needs the weight to hold its strokes together. The exception covers numbers only, never words.

rules.name: The State-Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. A shadow and a 1px upward transform appear only on hover; the focus ring appears only for keyboard users.

rules.name: The Resting-Band Rule
rules.body: Surfaces still rest flat. Exactly one card per screen may carry a Step 2 shadow at rest when it is the deliberate emphasis band, and it replaces a hover lift rather than adding to one. In dark mode the border still does most of the work.

dos: Do reserve Teletype Violet for action, selection, focus, and active state only.
Do build new settings from the shared primitives so a new section cannot drift into a new look.
Do make the whole row the click target and keep interactive rows about 44px tall.
Do use the 12px radius for cards, 8px for controls, and 999px for pills and chips.
Do lift on hover with Step 2 shadow plus a 1px transform, and show the focus ring only via :focus-visible.
Do carry dark-mode depth with a slightly stronger border, not a bigger shadow.
Do use warning (amber) for 'needs a download' and 'applies next take'; reserve danger red for real errors.
donts: Don't introduce a second chromatic accent; violet is the only action color.
Don't push type weight above 650 (display) or 600 (body), or working text above 28px. The metric numeral tiers are the sanctioned exception, and only for a measured number.
Don't rest more than one surface in shadow on a screen; elevation is otherwise a response to hover, focus, or a raised layer.
Don't let placeholder or tertiary text do the reading.
Don't style the floating pill with the app's tokens; it is a dark, isolated signature surface.
Don't use multi-pixel borders, hard square corners on cards, or glassmorphism.
